title: Finn's More Variants
description: Adds simple new block variants, additions, and forms!
body:
Adds more variants of blocks, some of which reuse seldom seen Minecraft textures as decorative blocks! 

**Features:**

- Stonecut Blocks: variants of blocks that reuse textures from functional blocks with multiple side textures, turning them into full blocks, to make texturing on all angles easier.
- Stumps: Slab variants of all log types, to make for immersive forests and cabins. 
- Mince Meat: Compressed blocks of meat types. The new textures could be nice for a butcher shop or horror map!
- Stone Fences: Fence variants for stone types, good for crumbling caves or stalagmite pillars
- The Abomination: ???

This mod is still in an early phase and most blocks are planned to be improved or get more versions.

**Plans:**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

-More Stonecut variants
-All meats as Mince Meat
-All stone types as fences
-Stripped Stumps
-Wooden Walls
-Leaf variants
-Weapon customization 
-Totem variants

</details>
